description: This Java class defines configuration properties for a server component within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes settings such as payload size limits, tenant mode, logging options, downstream connection behaviors, AMQP link credits, and CORS configuration.

classes.name: ServiceConfigProperties
classes.description: A POJO for configuring common properties of server components in the Eclipse Hono project, extending ServerConfig and providing customizable settings like payload size, tenant mode, logging, connection waiting, link credits, and CORS.

methods.name: setMaxPayloadSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of a message payload that the server accepts from clients. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the size is less than or equal to the minimum (128 bytes).

methods.name: getMaxPayloadSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum payload size accepted.

methods.name: isSingleTenant
methods.description: Checks if the server is configured to run in single-tenant mode, where clients do not need to specify a tenant component.

methods.name: setSingleTenant
methods.description: Configures whether the server operates in single-tenant mode.

methods.name: isNetworkDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if TCP traffic debug logging is enabled.

methods.name: setNetworkDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables network debug logging.

methods.name: isWaitForDownstreamConnectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the server is configured to wait for downstream connections during startup.

methods.name: setWaitForDownstreamConnectionEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the server should wait for downstream connections during startup.

methods.name: getReceiverLinkCredit
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for AMQP receiver link credits.

methods.name: setReceiverLinkCredit
methods.description: Sets the number of AMQP message credits to flow to clients; throws exception if less than 1.

methods.name: getCorsAllowedOrigin
methods.description: Returns the configured CORS allowed origin pattern.

methods.name: setCorsAllowedOrigin
methods.description: Sets the allowed origin pattern for CORS, ensuring the argument is not null.
